WITH trader_transaction_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradereg,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradereg, t.tradekind
),
total_transactions AS (
  SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count FROM trader_transaction_counts
),
trader_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ttc.tradereg,
    ttc.tradekind,
    ttc.transaction_count,
    CAST(ttc.transaction_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(tot.total_count AS DECIMAL) AS share
  FROM trader_transaction_counts ttc
  CROSS JOIN total_transactions tot
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count,
    AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM trader_shares
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT 
  tradekind AS trader_type,
  average_count,
  average_share
FROM type_averages
ORDER BY trader_type
